decisions.statement: A refund note names the item that came back.
The item a refund note names is drawn from the order that bought that item.
A refund whose order does not settle which item came back is reported and not written.
A credit matching several refunds is abstained on and never written.
The order confirmations are read through the same reader the notes path uses.
A message missing the amount or the order number or the item is counted rather than dropped.
The before-picture of every Amazon row is taken before anything is written.

definition: the Amazon refund notices matched to credits and written on as notes
